post.text: NASA Artemis passing close to the Moon https://t.co/jLvGoW1IR9

description.description: A close-up of a spaceship with the moon in the background. It is a large, grey, cratered moon which reflects the light of the sun and is against a pitch-black background. There is a small, blue and white earth in the distance, barely visible as a speck in the sky. The camera is slightly tilted and moves as the spaceship continues its flight.
